closer_vs_comeback.estimand: win rate given a 10k lead minus win rate given a 10k deficit

death_clustering.estimand: share of death-to-death gaps at or under 90 seconds

deaths_alone_share.estimand: mean per-match share of deaths in a minute with no team kill activity

fight_conversion.estimand: rate a won fight minute is followed by an enemy tower within two minutes

lane_to_map.estimand: own net worth at minute 20, won lane minus lost lane

lane_vs_jungle_share.estimand: mean per-match share of creep gold taken from neutrals

spike_usage.estimand: mean seconds from first real item to next kill or assist (the census reports the median of the same series)

vision_coverage.estimand: mean per-match share of minutes with an own observer ward alive
